description.blurb: S/2019 S 1 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2019 and announced in 2021.
description.more: S/2019 S 1 is about 5 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 11.2 million km in 445.513 days. It has an inclination of 49.5° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.623.
